summary: Of 60 scheduled runs, Melbourne has 20 passes; Frankfurt has 18 passes and 2 failures; Singapore has 19 passes and 1 missing run. Totals: 57 passed, 2 failed, 1 missing and 59 executed. The selected failure completes its first 3 steps in 730 ms, then Payment times out after 1,500 ms: 2,230 ms elapsed. Confirmation is Not run.
constraints: The first slice imports or exposes external recorded runs. Native execution, scheduling, retry and credentials are separate work.
Runner, browser and journey versions, location, and assertion definitions govern compatibility.
A missing run requires a schedule manifest. Without one, coverage is unknown.
Not run is not a 0 ms pass. Step and elapsed intervals must reconcile.
Artifacts are sanitized and authorized. Trace links require verified correlation. Label the observations as test traffic.
